title: Kings Landing

services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: Engage your school group in an unforgettable adventure at Kings Landing! Discover the rich history of New Brunswick while exploring the village and its interactive experiences. For additional information and rates, contact Zoe Leger. To receive educational program rates, you must book in advance. Leading up to Military Muster Weekend (Saturday September 26th & Sunday September 27th) is Free Education Day this year on Friday September 25th. services.name: History Lessons
services.desc: Enjoy our series of free history lessons for kids! Each lesson is based on a request from a child and includes a history lesson and hands-on activity. Many have printable recipes and crafts to go along with the lesson’s topic. Let us know your suggestions and we’ll add them to our idea bank for upcoming lessons. Submit your idea here! blurb: As one of Canada's premiere tourist attractions, Kings Landing pushes the boundaries of living history museums. Guests are invited to roll up their sleeves and pitch in to experience the history and culture of 19th-century rural New Brunswick.
